feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 16 May 2026 8:30pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Saturday, 16 May 2026 at 8:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

A few isolated showers at first, becoming mostly dry with clear spells overnight and temperatures no lower than 6 Celsius.

Generally dry and bright tomorrow morning with sunny intervals, but getting showers during the afternoon and evening. Moderate to fresh west-southwest winds; top temperature about 13°C.


##Outlook##

Dry with bright or sunny spells on Monday, then cloud increasing by the evening ahead of a belt of rain arriving later and into early Tuesday with a strengthening southerly wind.

5:12am Tomorrow
